name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 24, 2014
08:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Frank Harper, a member of the community.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Letter of Appreciation to Battalion Chief Joe Napier
P2.
Proclamation declaring Thursday, June 26, 2014, to be "Jeanette Farris Day" in the City of Vista in recognition of her years of service.
P3.
Certificates of Appointment to incoming Commission, Board, and Committee Members.
P4.
Recognition of Participants of the Linda Rhoades Recreation Center Mural Competition
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Woman's Club of Vista Donation (CC)
C4.
2014 League Conference Voting Delegate and Alternate (CC)
C5.
Vista Civic Center Security Services (CC)
C6.
CIP No. 8125 Sewer Easement Agreement and Quitclaim Deed with Cabrillo Power I, LLC (CC)
C7.
Second Amendment to National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) San Diego Regional Co-Permittees Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) (CC)
C8.
Automated Green Waste Collection (CC)
C9.
Live Entertainment Ordinance Amendment (CC)
C10.
Sale of Successor Agency and City Properties (CC/SA)
1.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- , 635 S. Santa Fe Avenue;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , 1550 N. Santa Fe Avenue; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , 102 and 103 Buna Place.
C11.
Revisions to the Vista Municipal Code Related to Electronic Smoking (CC)
1.
Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 8.12 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Smoking in Public";
2.
Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 8.16 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Possession of Smoking Materials by Minors"; and
3.
Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 12.08 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Smoking in Public Parks."
DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Food Vending Vehicles (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Vista Business Park Specific Plan;
2.
Introduce and adopt the following City Council Ordinances:
a.
Ordinance No. 2014 , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving an Amendment to the Vista Business Park Specific Plan"; and
b.
Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 8.24 of the Vista Municipal Code Concerning Food Vending Vehicles."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
